steps.do: On your iPhone, open the link below in Safari (not inside the Claude app). Sign in with your bars-engine account if it asks; it brings you back to the garden. Then tap the floor somewhere to walk.

Tend the spark once: tap "Tend the spark" in the bar at the bottom, pick what you are bringing, write a line, and send it. If you see the sheet asking who the garden is with instead of a spark, fill it in with the same name, kind and hopes you used in the old garden; that plants it again here.

note: Recorded by board/pull.py. needs_work lists what a session still has to act on.
